description: Header file defining the HdmiInput class, which manages HDMI input devices and related operations as part of a plugin in the WPEFramework. It declares methods for device management, EDID reading/writing, and event handling, along with internal data members and helper functions.

classes.name: HdmiInput
classes.description: Represents the HDMI input plugin, managing HDMI devices, EDID data, and handling HDMI hotplug events within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

methods.name: HdmiInput
methods.description: Constructor for the HdmiInput plugin class.

methods.name: ~HdmiInput
methods.description: Destructor for the HdmiInput plugin class.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Terminates the plugin, performing necessary cleanup.

methods.name: InitializeIARM
methods.description: Initializes the IARM (Inter-Application Resource Management) system.

methods.name: getHDMIInputDevicesWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper function to handle requests for getting HDMI input devices.

methods.name: writeEDIDWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper function to handle writing EDID data to a device.

methods.name: readEDIDWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper function to handle reading EDID data.

methods.name: startHdmiInput
methods.description: Wrapper function to initiate HDMI input.

methods.name: stopHdmiInput
methods.description: Wrapper function to stop HDMI input.

methods.name: getHDMIInputDevices
methods.description: Retrieves the list of available HDMI input devices.

methods.name: writeEDID
methods.description: Writes EDID data to a specified device.

methods.name: hdmiInputHotplug
methods.description: Handles HDMI hotplug events, triggered when an HDMI device is connected or disconnected.

methods.name: dsHdmiEventHandler
methods.description: Static callback function for handling HDMI events from IARM.
